newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Chemical to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Chemical to buy back shares.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp, which makes specialty chemicals, said Thursday its board voted to increase the share repurchase authority by up to an additional four million shares.
Earlier, Great Lakes said it expected to receive about a $300 million special distribution as part of its plan to spin off its Octel petroleum additives business.

"Proceeds from the special distribution will be used to build on the company's core competencies in specialty chemicals through internal investments and strategic acquisitions and, if conditions warrant, to repurchase shares of Great Lakes stock," Robert McDonald, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
